## MongoDB Falls 17.4% Post-Earnings Despite Raised Guidance and New APAC AI Hire

MDB's raised-guide-but-steep-selloff mirrors GWRE and signals a broader market dynamic: investors are discounting near-term beats and focusing on medium-term growth deceleration risk in enterprise AI infrastructure; this pattern, appearing across multiple names in a single digest, deserves a portfolio-level theme flag.

- MDB sold off 17.4% following its earnings report.
- The company raised guidance — the selloff is despite, not because of, the forward outlook.
- A new APAC AI-focused hire was announced, signaling geographic expansion ambition.
- Market appears to be pricing in growth deceleration beyond the near-term guide.
